mapper.update: UPDATE run SET status = 'paused', pause_kind = #{kind}, pause_reason = #{reason}, paused_at = now(), pause_node_key = #{nodeKey}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{runId} AND status = 'running'

UPDATE experiment e SET status = 'running', started_at = COALESCE(e.started_at, now()), updated_at = now() FROM experiment_run r WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.id = #{runId} AND e.id = r.experiment_id

UPDATE experiment e SET status = ${caseSql}, started_at = COALESCE(e.started_at, r.started_at), finished_at = r.finished_at, updated_at = now() FROM experiment_run r WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND r.id = #{runId} AND e.id = r.experiment_id

UPDATE experiment e SET status = ${caseSql}, updated_at = now() FROM experiment_run r WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND e.id = r.experiment_id AND r.status = 'paused' AND e.status IN ('queued', 'running')
UPDATE experiment SET status = 'running', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, now()), finished_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{experimentId}

UPDATE experiment SET status = #{aggregate}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, now()), finished_at = CASE WHEN #{aggregate} IN ('finished', 'failed') THEN now() ELSE NULL END, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{experimentId}
